name: Luke's Way
source:
Luke's Way is a story about Luke who moved in a new city searching for a better job and better life. He manage to find a job that will change his life in a company called L.P.. On his first day at work, he is invited to a welcoming party which turns out is a massive orgy. After only a few days, Michelle admits that she likes Luke from the first time she saw him and they both start a romantic relationship and she will offer him a bigger role at her company and a free pass for fun with other girls.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/eviluser]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《卢克之路》讲述了卢克搬到新城市寻找更好的工作和更好的生活的故事。他设法在一家名为L.P. 的公司找到了一份将改变他生活的工作。上班第一天，他受邀参加一场欢迎派对，结果却是一场盛大的狂欢。仅仅几天后，米歇尔承认，她从第一次见到卢克时就喜欢上了他，他们都开始了恋爱关系，她将为他提供在公司更重要的职位，并提供与其他女孩一起玩耍的免费通行证。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/eviluser]Patreon[/url]]
